title: Tavern talk
description: Three turns of ordinary talk in a tavern: a greeting, a question about work, a joke. No stakes; the texture of the game master's voice.

steps.say: I leave the square, find the nearest inn, shake the rain off my cloak and ask the innkeeper what's hot tonight.
I ask whoever is nearest whether there's honest work in the village this week.
I raise my cup and tell the room the one about the reeve and the goat.
